title: CodeTD: Topology of Attention Detects Hallucinations in Code LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.07779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As AI-code assistant tools become widespread, automatic assessment of the correctness of generated code becomes a significant challenge. Code LLMs are prone to hallucinations, which may lead to code that does not solve the required problem, or even to code with severe security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we introduce CodeTD -- the first approach to pre-execution assessment of code correctness based on topological data analysis (TDA) of Code LLMs' attention maps. Our method quantifies prompt-generation mismatch using topological patterns of attention maps. We carry out experiments with common benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, BigCodeBench, MultiPL-E), 5 programming languages and 10 Code LLMs of size up to 34B parameters. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms recent baselines. Moreover, CodeTD is transferable between coding benchmarks.

translated_title: CodeTD：注意力拓扑检测代码大语言模型中的幻觉
translated_abstract: 随着AI代码助手工具的日益普及，自动评估生成代码的正确性成为一项重大挑战。代码大语言模型（Code LLMs）容易产生幻觉，这可能导致代码无法解决所需的问题，甚至产生存在严重安全漏洞的代码。在本文中，我们提出了CodeTD——首个基于代码大语言模型注意力图的拓扑数据分析（TDA）的代码执行前正确性评估方法。我们的方法利用注意力图的拓扑模式来量化提示与生成结果之间的不匹配。我们在常见基准（HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench、MultiPL-E）、5种编程语言以及10个参数规模最高达34B的代码大语言模型上进行了实验。实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于近期基线方法。此外，CodeTD可在不同编程基准之间迁移。
tldr: CodeTD是首个基于代码大语言模型注意力图拓扑数据分析的执行前幻觉检测方法，可预测生成代码的正确性，性能超越现有基线且能跨编程基准迁移。
en_tdlr: CodeTD is the first pre-execution hallucination detection approach for Code LLMs based on topological data analysis of attention maps, outperforming recent baselines and transferring across coding benchmarks.
